protocol.calibration: per system per week, OLS of actual margin on [1, rating difference, site], fitted on the out-of-sample walk-forward predictions already accumulated earlier in the same season (report 02 §3.3); the training window is the fallback until 40 out-of-sample games exist
protocol.prediction_source_note: a system whose prediction source is not itself is a RETRODICTIVE rating scored on violations, and predicts through the rating it was built on (report 02 §3.5, backtest/baselines/__init__.py)
protocol.walk_forward: fit through bucket N-1 of the same season, predict bucket N
